title: DYNAMIS Job
description: A market job (docs/03-protocol.md §1). Spec is a schema-validated object, never prose. Escrow is µ¢; revenue_ref binds the job to a real payer (Law 19).

spec.description: Task descriptor; at minimum {task, inputs_ref, output_contract}. Job-type schemas register in the job-type registry (specs/benchmarks.md §4).

verification_class.description: Attestation ladder class; must be >= floor_class(escrow) per Law 9 (impl/dynamis_core/ladder.py).

revenue_ref.description: Entity budget envelope or external payment reference — the payer that makes this a business flow (Law 19).

rc2_accepted.description: Worker may take part of payment in RC² credits at the witness ERG rate.

muc.description: USDS µ¢; 1 µ¢ = 10⁻⁶ USDS. Floats forbidden (ADR-0007).
